Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

ballast 0.4.0 (development, 16 October 2026)

  • Specs from an mmrm fit (stress_spec_mmrm()) and from an ADaM BDS data set (stress_spec_adam()).
  • Three or more arms: active chooses the comparison; stress_visits() gives the contrast at every visit; run_plans() runs several endpoints or comparisons and summarises them together.
  • standard_plan(): the recommended, citable set of families.
  • stress_estimand(): intercurrent-event strategies (treatment policy, hypothetical, while on treatment, composite) derived from an event table.
  • stress_explain(): attributes an alternative’s shift to subjects.
  • Deliverables: stress_tables() (CSV, Word, RTF), stress_log() (audit trail with the plan’s hash), stress_html() (interactive report).
  • simulate_trial() and stress_calibrate(): pre-trial calibration of the verdict.
  • Vignettes: quickstart, interpreting the verdict, missing data, for SAS users.

ballast 0.3.0

  • Pre-specification: stress_plan(), run_plan(), stress_report().
  • stress_weights() and the weights setting (equal versus observed-margins least-squares means); cLDA estimator; fast path for the re-randomisation test.
  • Validation: rbmi cross-check of the reference-based imputation; re-randomisation and cLDA gates.

ballast 0.2.0

  • Reference-based multiple imputation (stress_reference()), the sensitivity/supplementary role, the greedy deletion search (stress_fragility()), the estimator-class family (stress_estimator()).

ballast 0.1.0

  • Engine, nine families, census, verdict and the three displays; validated against a SAS robustness package.
